notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Divinity II: Developer's Cut" or "Divinity II". divinity.fandom.com answers the API, with about 47 linked pages, including "Aleroth", "Battle Tower", "Divinity II: Ego Draconis", "Divinity II: Flames of Vengeance", "Divinity II: Dragon Knight Saga" and list pages such as "Dragon Knight Saga Quests"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 219780 returned an empty achievement schema (no game name, no achievements) and HTTP 403 for global percentages, so steam is set to none. RAWG's description says the Developer's Cut includes "the ultimate edition of Divinity II", a Developer Mode, a "Hatching the Dragon" documentary and a "Treasure Vault"; the extras chapter comes from that. Whether the Flames of Vengeance content is in this edition is not stated in the data; it is a guess from the Fandom page names and needs checking. Chapter order is not known. RAWG lists a playtime of only 2 hours, while its description says "100+ hours".
